coder_notes: Only experimental agent is a CAR T-cell therapy (excluded type). Cy/Flu (cyclophosphamide + fludarabine) is lymphodepleting conditioning in cohort 4 only (not a registered intervention), coded supportive per R6. Temozolomide not a registered intervention but all patients undergo standard chemoradiation (XRT/TMZ) before CAR T; listed as soc_backbone. CD70 eligibility biomarker is the CAR target but the CAR T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. cns5 historical: 'WHO Grade IV glioma' and 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' without IDH requirement. Official title also mentions paediatric HGG but eligibility shown is adult GBM only.
